title: 第20章 吞金兽的紧迫感
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
青云洲域，南域谢家。

    谢家家主谢闻笙刚收到自己大儿子传来的简讯：“父亲，儿子不日将归，两日后会带着师弟师妹抵达南域，此行有贵客同行，望父亲提前做好准备。”

    第一次见到大儿子传讯中提到贵客，谢闻笙捋了捋下颌处的胡子。

    之前泽儿带着归鸿剑尊回家小住时都没提到贵客，看来这次要带回来的人身份不一般啊。

    就在谢闻笙思考大儿子口中这位贵客是何身份之际，一道低沉磁性的声音从他身后传来，男人微微低头：“父亲，你找我？”

    来人一身玄墨色云纹长袍，头束玉冠，剑眉星目，五官挺拔俊朗，下颌线流畅，即使在修仙界里，也是难得一见的美男子。

    “长流你来了，为父刚刚收到你大哥的消息，他两日后会带着太虚宗同门到南域游玩，此行有贵客同行，你做好接待准备。用谢家待客的最高规格，切记不可怠慢。”

    能让他这个大儿子说出贵客一词，来人身份绝对不可小觑。

    “知道了父亲，我会办好的。”男人微微颔首，应下了差事。

    只是低头的刹那，在谢闻笙看不到的地方，眼神里微微漏出点不屑。

    “嗯，那你下去准备吧。”

    两日后，一路走走停停观赏沿路风景的一行人终于抵达了南域边界。

    这两天里，借着渡星槎上浓郁的灵气，濮阳明珠一举突破练气巅峰，进入筑基初期，林不语则是从筑基后期突破至筑基巅峰。

    大师兄和二师姐虽没突破，却也进一步稳固修为。

    只有微生璃月辛辛苦苦一个月，结果才从练气五层进入练气六层。

    丹田里那些灵根们像是吃不饱的饕餮一样，但凡是来一点灵气，全被它们给吞了，一点不留，给微生璃月都弄麻了。

    按照她目前的修炼进度，原剧情里叶不凡三个月后就会突破练气进入筑基。

    如果她那时候还是练气，那该怎么在宗门大比上装？

    为此，微生璃月不得不加快吸收灵气的速度，她的灵根们不是贪吃嘛，那自己就让它们吃个够。

    渡星槎主卧，依旧是灵气幻化成的蝉茧里，大量灵气不断涌入微生璃月的每一寸经脉，在经过疯狂乱窜后抵达丹田处的灵根林。
content_en:
Qingyunzhou Territory, Xie Family in the Southern Territory.

The head of the Xie family, Xie Wensheng, just received a text message from his eldest son: "Father, my son will be returning soon. He will arrive in the Southern Territory with his junior brothers and sisters in two days. There will be distinguished guests on this trip. I hope my father will be prepared in advance."

It was the first time that Xie Wensheng saw the distinguished guest mentioned in the summons of his eldest son. Xie Wensheng smoothed the beard on his chin.

Ze'er didn't mention the distinguished guest when she brought Gui Hongjianzun home for a short stay before. It seems that the identity of the person she wants to bring back this time is unusual.

Just when Xie Wensheng was thinking about the identity of this distinguished guest in his eldest son's mouth, a deep magnetic voice came from behind him. The man lowered his head slightly: "Father, are you looking for me?"

The person who came was wearing a dark black moire robe, a jade crown on his head, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, tall and handsome facial features, and a smooth jawline. Even in the world of immortality, he was a rare handsome man.

"Changliu, you are here. My father has just received news from your eldest brother. He will take his fellow disciples from the Taixu Sect to the Southern Region in two days. There will be distinguished guests on this trip, so be prepared to receive them. Use the highest standards of hospitality of the Xie family, and remember not to neglect."

For his eldest son to be able to say the word distinguished guest, the identity of the visitor must not be underestimated.

"I know father, I will take care of it." The man nodded slightly and accepted the errand.

Just when he lowered his head, where Xie Wensheng couldn't see, there was a slight hint of disdain in his eyes.

"Well, then go down and get ready."

Two days later, the group of people who walked and stopped to admire the scenery along the way finally arrived at the border of the Southern Territory.

In the past two days, with the help of the rich spiritual energy on Duxingcha, Puyang Mingzhu broke through the peak of Qi training and entered the early stage of foundation building. Lin Buyu broke through from the late stage of foundation building to the peak of foundation building.

Although the senior brother and second senior sister did not achieve a breakthrough, they further stabilized their cultivation.

Only Wei Sheng Liyue worked hard for a month and finally moved from the fifth level of Qi training to the sixth level of Qi training.

The spiritual roots in the dantian were like gluttons that couldn't get enough to eat. Whenever there was a little spiritual energy, they were swallowed up by them, leaving nothing behind. Even Wei Sheng Liyue was numb.

According to her current training progress, in the original plot, Ye Bufan would break through Qi training and enter Foundation building in three months.

If she was still practicing Qi at that time, how would she dress up in the sect competition?

For this reason, Weisheng Liyue had to speed up the speed of absorbing spiritual energy. Her spiritual roots were not greedy, so she would let them eat as much as she could.

The master bedroom of Du Xingcha was still in a cicada cocoon transformed by spiritual energy. A large amount of spiritual energy continued to pour into every inch of the meridians of Liyue, and after a crazy run, it arrived at the spiritual root forest at the Dantian.
